title: Planner dev5 capacity-domain tickets and XTP pacing
summary: Planner dev5 names shared capacity domains and can suspend/refresh live tickets; XTP dev25 supports rate-limited named-service unicast. Queue Fabric needs its own admission accounting before CLAIM.
invariants: Acquire allowed ticket before side effects; WLU admission remains pre-CLAIM.
XTP capacityRate per context is not aggregate accounting; Planner governor enforces domain parallelism and aggregate caps.
Under operating-state pressure, reconcile and suspend zero-rate contexts without losing durable transfer identity.
No unapproved fallback or deadline bypass under congestion; obey both ticket rate and receiver RATE/BURST.
